title: AxionLimitBench: can AI curate a dark matter constraint repository?

creators.name: Yuan, Lanqing
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Washington University in St. Louis

notes: If you use AxionLimitBench, please cite it and the AxionLimits compilation that provides the reference curves.
description:
AxionLimitBench v0.1.3 updates the PDU evaluation supplement with standalone pointwise-agreement rates, 95% bootstrap intervals for pointwise agreement and joint success, and the pointwise-agreement distribution figure. The original benchmark, scorer, task card, baseline arms and leaderboard definition are unchanged.

The supplement includes frozen inputs, offline reproduction scripts and results, dual mass-range coverage analyses, outcome audits, and the 100-paper agent repeatability study with all 200 predictions and extraction transcripts. Analysis and transcript archives with SHA-256 checksums are included in the GitHub release and mirrored on Hugging Face. Offline reproduction was verified. No new extraction was performed for this update.

The companion manuscript (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22880507) has been accepted to ML4PS 2026. Private revision conversations, referee correspondence, the revised PDU manuscript and input paper PDFs are not included.
